summary_en: 3,000,000 ordinary shares to be cancelled effective 2026-08-31. Cancellation comprises 1,400,000 shares acquired under the buyback program announced 2025-08-19 plus 1,600,000 shares held in treasury. Post-cancellation issued shares outstanding: 15,000,000 (20.0% reduction from current base).
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: NCS&A's board resolved on 2026-07-30 to cancel 3,000,000 ordinary shares effective 2026-08-31 under Companies Act Article 178. The cancellation combines 1,400,000 shares acquired under the buyback program authorized on 2025-08-19 (which remains in execution through 2026-07-31) and 1,600,000 shares already held in treasury. Current issued shares outstanding total 18,150,433; post-cancellation, issued shares will be 15,000,000, a 20.0% reduction. Treasury shares will decline from 3,150,433 to 150,433.
